no_rule_findings.finding: Home-rule petition H.3744 (193rd General Court) to let Boston implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections was not enacted; it was accompanied by a study order (H5035) on 9/9/2024. No local rent stabilization authority exists from this bill.
Home-rule petition H.3744 also sought tenant eviction protections for Boston but was sent to a study order (H5035) and not enacted, so no local just-cause eviction rule results from it.
no_rule_findings.quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections

parsed.doc_summary: Bill history page for H.3744 (2023-2024), a Boston home-rule petition for rent stabilization and eviction protections. It was sent to a study order (H5035) on 9/9/2024 and not enacted. The page gives no operative text, so it supports no-rule findings only.
